name: Z-Image Turbo
summary: The fastest good image model here: 8 steps, photoreal people, English and Chinese text. Runs on small GPUs.
description: Z-Image Turbo is a 6B single-stream diffusion model distilled to 8 steps, so a 1-megapixel picture takes seconds on a mid-range card. Strong at photographic people and scenes and at short text in English and Chinese. It has no negative prompt and works best with a plain, concrete description. Bhippi runs it through ComfyUI with ComfyUI's own Z-Image Turbo workflow.

license.name: Apache 2.0

name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
summary: Distilled FLUX.2 in 4 steps: sharp pictures in about a second on a good card, plus image editing. Apache 2.0, fine for commercial work.
description: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B is Black Forest Labs' small distilled model: 4 steps, no negative prompt, good prompt following and clean detail, and the same weights edit a picture from an instruction ("change the bag to blue"). It is the commercially friendliest fast model in the library (Apache 2.0). Bhippi uses the distilled 4-step workflow.

name: ERNIE-Image Turbo
summary: Baidu's 8-step image model: strong layout and readable text, English and Chinese. Apache 2.0.
description: ERNIE-Image Turbo makes pictures in 8 steps with a good grip on layout, posters and lettering in English and Chinese. It takes long, descriptive prompts and has no negative prompt. The big text model makes it heavier than Z-Image Turbo, so give it a 12 GB card or more. Bhippi runs it through ComfyUI with the prompt enhancer switched off, because Bhippi's AI writes the prompt itself.

name: Qwen Image 2.1
summary: The best text and typography in an open image model, up to native 2K, with transparent (RGBA) pictures and editing with reference images. Research licence: not for commercial use.
description: Qwen Image 2.1 makes and edits pictures with one 7B model: posters and layouts with accurate lettering, portraits with believable lighting, transparent assets, and instruction edits that keep a person or product recognisable (up to 10 reference images; Bhippi passes two). Write long, concrete natural-language prompts and put any text that must appear in quotes. It uses 25 steps. The licence only allows research and evaluation, so do not use it for paid or monetised work.

name: Qwen Image Edit 2511
summary: Edits a picture from an instruction and up to two reference images: change colours, swap materials, restyle, keep the subject. Apache 2.0.
description: Qwen Image Edit 2511 is a 20B editing model: give it a picture and a plain instruction ("change the furniture leather in image 1 to the fur material in image 2") and it changes only what you asked, keeping people, products and layout. It runs at the picture's own shape. 40 steps by default; the optional 4-step Lightning add-on makes it about ten times faster. A big model: 12 GB of video memory with offloading, 48 GB of RAM.

name: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo
summary: Full songs with sung lyrics, from style tags and lyrics: up to four minutes, 8 steps, any genre, 50 languages. Apache 2.0.
description: ACE-Step 1.5 XL is a 4B music model that writes a whole song at once: vocals singing your lyrics, drums, bass and harmony, in the style you describe. The Turbo version needs only 8 steps. Give it comma-separated style tags (genre, mood, instruments, vocal type), lyrics with [verse] / [chorus] section tags, a length, and optionally the tempo, key and language. Bhippi saves lossless FLAC. A 12 GB card is the practical minimum.

name: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo
summary: The small ACE-Step 1.5: songs with lyrics in 8 steps on a modest GPU. Apache 2.0.
description: The standard-size ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo writes songs with sung lyrics from style tags and lyrics, like the XL model but lighter: it runs on 6 GB of video memory. Pick Standard for the better text encoder or Compact for a smaller one. Saved as MP3.

name: Stable Audio 3 Medium
summary: Sound effects, loops, instruments and instrumental music up to 6 minutes, in about a second. Free for businesses under US$1M a year.
description: Stable Audio 3 Medium (1.4B) turns a text description into stereo 44.1 kHz audio: sound effects, one-shots, instrument loops, ambience and instrumental tracks, up to 380 seconds, in 8 fast steps. It does not sing lyrics: use ACE-Step for songs. Describe the sound like a sound designer would: source, material, space, mood, and for music the genre, tempo and instruments. Bhippi saves lossless FLAC.

license.name: Stability AI Community License (Stable Audio)
summary: Free for personal use and for businesses and creators whose total annual revenue is under US$1 million. A larger organisation needs a commercial licence from Stability AI.
The text encoder inside the download is Google's T5Gemma, which comes with its own Gemma terms of use.
Read the full licence on the model page before relying on it for paid work.

variants.label: Standard

name: YuE 2 · 3B
summary: Full songs with vocals from a style and lyrics, planned as sheet music first. Non-commercial licence.
description: YuE 2 writes a song in two steps: it plans the melody and chords as a symbolic score, then performs it with vocals and accompaniment. Write the style (genre, voice, language, tempo, instruments) and the lyrics with [Verse] / [Chorus] tags; put musical directions in the style, not the lyrics. Songs run up to two minutes here and come out at the length the lyrics need. The licence is CC BY-NC: personal and non-commercial use only. For songs you can use commercially, pick ACE-Step.
